row:
Unlock tension in your horse's body with a blend of physiotherapy, fascial maneouvres and intention. 
Welcome to my channel where I will show you my approach to equine bodywork. These videos are based on my own experience combined with Human Garage inspired fascial maneouvres. Through using these techniques I have been able to release tension, increase range of motion and support the horse's well-being. 

In each video, I'll show the techniques that meld hands-on physiotherapy, fascia-focused movement and intentional awareness -- designed to reconnect flow and balance with ease. 

Subscribe to see more videos, tips and insights into equine holistic care.
